## EMST role: Environmental compliance inspector (state variant, journey level; P1)

*Match:* `skos:broadMatch`, confidence 0.55, unreviewed agent draft (`emst-x5-tx:R12-environmental-compliance-inspector/state:2652`). *Authority position (editorial):* regulator.

**Competency targets at this level (agent draft)**

- Conduct regulatory compliance inspections — journey L2 *(distinguishing)*
- Work safely on hazardous, industrial and energized field sites — journey L2
- Target inspections and verify compliance using monitoring data and analytics — journey L2
- Validate AI-generated work products before professional use — journey L2
- Manage field sample custody and field quality control — journey L2
- Maintain independence and manage conflicts of interest across the regulator-regulated boundary — journey L2
- Build and maintain a defensible administrative record — journey L2
- Develop and resolve environmental enforcement cases — journey L2
- Apply safety practices and stop-work authority across field, facility and incident settings — journey L2
- Communicate environmental and health risks under uncertainty — journey L2
- Use AI tools responsibly in everyday environmental work — journey L1
- Record field observations with protocol fidelity and data integrity — journey L2
- Provide compliance and technical assistance to regulated entities and local governments — journey L2
- Assure the quality of environmental data from collection to release — journey L2
- Maintain the integrity of regulatory and scientific findings under institutional pressure — journey L2

**Main tasks at this level (indicative % of time, agent draft)**

- Inspect a permitted facility or site against its permit conditions and applicable rules, recording observations, measurements and samples as evidence — 17.1% *(critical, needed at entry)*
- Write an inspection report stating findings of fact for each condition inspected, separating the inspector's observations from conclusions — 13.2% *(critical, needed at entry)*
- Plan a compliance inspection from the facility's permit, compliance history and monitoring reports, listing the conditions to verify and the evidence to collect — 8.8% *(critical, needed at entry)*
- Collect samples and photographs during an inspection under chain-of-custody procedures, so that the evidence is admissible in an enforcement proceeding — 8.8% *(critical, needed at entry)*
- Select the response the enforcement policy sets for each inspection finding, issuing a notice of violation, assistance letter or referral — 4.4%
- Collect grab water samples at locations and depths that represent the condition of interest, recording flow and site conditions at collection — 4.4% *(needed at entry)*
- Complete chain-of-custody records for every sample from collection to laboratory receipt, recording each transfer, seal and temperature check — 4.4% *(critical, needed at entry)*
- Investigate a reported environmental violation, establishing the facts, responsible party and applicable requirement before recommending an enforcement response — 4.4%
- Assemble the evidence file for an enforcement case, linking each alleged violation to the inspection findings, records and samples that prove it — 4.4%
- Review automated anomaly flags in facility monitoring reports, confirming or dismissing each flag against the underlying data before referral — 4.4% *(critical)*
- Verify a facility's self-reported emissions or discharge values against independent remote-sensing or ambient data, stating the discrepancy and its uncertainty — 4.4% *(critical)*
- Collect field duplicates, splits and blanks at the frequency the sampling plan specifies, labelling them so the laboratory cannot identify them — 2.2% *(needed at entry)*

*Credential gates (issuer verified):* 2 not shown until the issuer is verified

## EMST role: Environmental review specialist (state variant, journey level; P1)

*Match:* `skos:broadMatch`, confidence 0.4, unreviewed agent draft (`emst-x5-tx:R10-environmental-review-specialist/state:2652`). *Authority position (editorial):* regulator.

**Competency targets at this level (agent draft)**

- Build and maintain a defensible administrative record — journey L2
- Select, justify and document the appropriate level of environmental review — journey L2
- Conduct environmental impact review of proposed actions — journey L2 *(distinguishing)*
- Review effects of proposed actions on historic properties and resolve them through consultation — journey L2
- Validate AI-generated work products before professional use — journey L2
- Analyze regulatory, planning and public-comment text at scale with traceable citations — journey L2
- Assess effects on protected species and conduct interagency consultation on proposed actions — journey L2
- Direct and evaluate applicant- or contractor-prepared environmental documents — journey L2
- Coordinate lead, cooperating and participating agencies to a shared schedule — journey L2
- Communicate environmental and health risks under uncertainty — journey L2
- Analyze cumulative burdens and distributional effects of environmental decisions — journey L2
- Use AI tools responsibly in everyday environmental work — journey L1
- Quantify and communicate uncertainty for environmental decisions — journey L2
- Maintain independence and manage conflicts of interest across the regulator-regulated boundary — journey L2
- Design proportionate public engagement when participation is discretionary — journey L2
- Identify and analyze the parties affected by or interested in a decision — journey L2
- Maintain the integrity of regulatory and scientific findings under institutional pressure — journey L2

**Main tasks at this level (indicative % of time, agent draft)**

- Prepare an environmental assessment of a proposed action, analyzing the reasonably foreseeable effects of the action and its alternatives within the procedure's page and time limits — 17.7% *(critical, needed at entry)*
- Scope the review of a proposed action with cooperating agencies and the public, setting the purpose, alternatives and effects boundaries the analysis will cover — 9.3% *(critical)*
- Verify AI-drafted sections of an environmental document against the project record, correcting unsupported statements and recording which text was machine-drafted — 9.3% *(critical, needed at entry)*
- Screen a proposed action against the agency's exclusion categories and extraordinary-circumstance criteria, recording the screening result and its basis for the official — 9.3% *(needed at entry)*
- Determine whether a proposed action requires an environmental assessment or a full impact statement, documenting the significance reasoning in the project record — 4.7% *(critical)*
- Review automated exclusion-screening results for a batch of routine actions, confirming or overriding each flagged extraordinary circumstance — 4.7% *(critical)*
- Coordinate review steps with other agencies holding authority over the same action, so that duplicated analyses and conflicting requirements are identified early — 4.7%
- Index documents into the administrative record with dates, authors and provenance labels, marking which content was produced with AI assistance — 4.7% *(needed at entry)*
- Confirm that every substantive comment in a docket has a reasoned response, sampling machine-grouped comments for unique points the grouping missed — 4.7%
- Code a public comment set into themes with machine assistance, tracing every coded statement to its source passage before summarizing for decision-makers. — 4.7%
- Prepare a biological assessment for a proposed action, stating the effects determination for each listed species and critical habitat with supporting evidence — 4.7%
- Update public milestone and dashboard entries for a covered project, reconciling each entry against agency source documents every reporting period — 2.4%
